caseName: Baltimore & Ohio Southwestern Railroad v. United States
caseNameFull: Baltimore & Ohio Southwestern Railroad Company v. United States
summary: Error to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. George Hoadly, Mr. Judson Harmon, Mr. Edward Colston, Mr. A.-W. Goldsmith and Mr. Oscar Stoehr for plaintiff in error. The Solicitor General, Mr. Assistant to the Attorney General Todd and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Frierson for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
